headline.caveat: Cash-and-stock (incl. up to $400M contingent), announced Aug 2024, closed Mar 31, 2025. AMD kept the rack/systems design business and resold ZT's manufacturing arm to Sanmina for ~$3B.

realized_to_date.caveat: Closed; net cost after the ~$3B Sanmina manufacturing divestiture is roughly ~$2B for the design/talent assets retained.

nature_md: AMD bought ZT Systems — a leading designer/builder of hyperscale AI server and rack-scale systems — for $4.9B to gain the systems-engineering capability needed to sell full rack-level MI-series solutions (matching NVIDIA's NVL72 systems play), then divested ZT's manufacturing business to Sanmina for up to ~$3B (announced May 2025) while retaining ~1,200 design engineers. Sanmina became a preferred NPI manufacturing partner for AMD AI systems. Net effect: ~$2B for the design organization that underpins AMD's Helios rack platform and the OpenAI/Humain GW-scale deployments.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: AMD consolidated ZT at close (goodwill + intangibles + brief manufacturing revenue), then derecognized the manufacturing arm on the Sanmina sale; retained business is opex-heavy design capability serving AMD's data-center segment, not a standalone revenue line.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: ZT's private owners received cash and AMD stock; the manufacturing business transferred again to Sanmina for ~$3B (three-quarters cash), with Sanmina booking the fab assets and AMD retaining customer-facing systems design.

events.title: AMD agrees to sell ZT manufacturing business to Sanmina for ~$3B
